Google Docs & Sheets

Without setup, “Google Sheets / Google Docs” copies your data and opens a blank Google file. Press ⌘V / Ctrl+V there to paste it in.

For one-click upload into Google Drive, paste an OAuth client ID (Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials → Web application, with this page's address as an authorized origin, and the Drive API enabled). Direct upload works when the app is served over http(s), for example python3 -m http.server.
